question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for ‘Periphery’.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Centre'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate antonym for ‘Periphery’ is: **'Centre'.(केंद्र)**
 
• The word **‘Periphery’ **means outside the boundary of something.
 
 
• **Example**: *A fence was built around the periphery of the site.*
 
 
 
• The word **'Centre'** means place in the middle.
 
 
• **Example**: *There's a table in the centre of the room.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** '****Troops'** means a group of people come or go together or in large numbers.(सैनिकों)
 
• **'****Clatter' **means a continuous rattling sound as of hard objects falling or striking each other.(दस्तक)
 
• **'****Divine'** means of like God or a god.(दिव्य)
